scenario: A release authorization is granted for an exact deliverable digest; before execution the branch rebuilds and the pipeline offers a newer, nearly identical artifact under the same version label.

given.execution candidate: app at digest sha-b, same version label, one commit newer

when: the release executes with the drifted candidate

reasons: the authorization binds digest sha-a; sha-b is a different subject
act-time re-verification detects the drift and reports it
releasing sha-b requires a new authorization for sha-b
must_not: match the authorization on version label or branch instead of the anchored digest
proceed with a drift warning while deploying the unauthorized revision
retro-edit the authorization to cover the newer artifact
